hw.noNvidia: No NVIDIA device node was found. For Docker, install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host, then add `runtime: nvidia` and `NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all` in compose (or declare `deploy.resources.reservations.devices`, `docker run --gpus all`). NVIDIA cards don’t use /dev/dri, so don’t mount it if the host has no integrated graphics.
